nodes.label: HookEventSchema (Zod discriminated union of 14 hook events)
nodes.rationale: Discriminated union on hook_event_name gives TypeScript narrowing throughout the daemon. PRD field names corrected from live docs audit: SubagentStop uses `output` (not last_assistant_message) and `subagent_id` (not agent_id).
nodes.norm_label: hookeventschema (zod discriminated union of 14 hook events)

nodes.label: Observer contract (every handler returns exactly {})
nodes.rationale: The most important test in the codebase: no hook handler can ever return a decision field, guaranteeing the plugin only observes and never blocks tool calls. Enforced by a parametric test over all 14 event names.

nodes.label: Bun daemon (port-binding singleton)
nodes.rationale: Singleton enforced by binding 127.0.0.1:47821-47830. Writes runtime.json (port, token, pid) for shell-script discovery; 4-hour idle self-shutdown. Command hooks (not HTTP hooks) chosen because HTTP hooks are always synchronous.

nodes.label: Security gate (Bearer token + Host check + rate limit)
nodes.rationale: Host header restricted to localhost/127.0.0.1 as DNS-rebinding mitigation; Bearer token from runtime.json; 1000 events/min per session_id returning 200 no-op beyond limit.
nodes.norm_label: security gate (bearer token + host check + rate limit)

nodes.label: persistEvent + session lifecycle store
nodes.rationale: SQLite migration 001 defines sessions + events tables. subagent_id is a promoted column for subagent queries; all other event fields stay in payload_json. SessionEnd (not Stop) sets sessions.status='ended'.

nodes.label: SuperpowersWatcher (spec/plan file watcher)
nodes.rationale: Watches docs/superpowers/plans + specs, debounces 200ms, parses plans, diffs checkbox state, and infers phase. PostToolUse Edit/Write on a plan file triggers handleFileChange directly without waiting for the FS event.

nodes.label: parsePlan / ParsedPlan (line-by-line state machine)
nodes.rationale: Parser never throws; malformed checkboxes are skipped silently. Extracts title (first H1), tasks (### Task N:), files block, and todo/done steps. Lives in @cc/shared so both server and web depend on it.

nodes.label: diffCheckboxState (plan step change detection)
nodes.rationale: Zips tasks/steps by index, returns only entries where from != to. If task counts differ (plan restructured) it diffs only the overlapping range and ignores the rest.

nodes.label: inferPhase (forward-only phase inference)
nodes.rationale: Primary signal is InstructionsLoaded event file_path (executing-plans/subagent-driven-development=implement, writing-plans=plan, brainstorming=brainstorm); artifact presence is fallback. Forward-only: brainstorm<spec<plan<implement, never regresses within a session.

nodes.label: StoryService (file-backed story CRUD + SQLite cache)
nodes.rationale: Story .md file is canonical source of truth; SQLite is a cache rebuilt on start(). id format US-YYYY-MM-DD-<slug> validated by regex rejecting path traversal. update() writes file then updates DB directly without waiting for the watcher.

nodes.label: parseFrontmatter / StoryFrontmatter (Zod-validated)
nodes.rationale: Hand-rolled YAML frontmatter parser: splits on --- boundaries, parses key:value lines, validates with Zod. Required id/title/status/created; optional size/linked_spec/linked_plan.

nodes.label: WsServer (topic fan-out over Bun WebSocket)
nodes.rationale: Native Bun websocket: option, no external lib. Validates ?token= query param, keeps Map<WebSocket,Set<topic>>, subscribes to all bus events and fans out to clients whose topic set matches.

nodes.label: Migration 002_superpowers (stories, plan_tasks, plan_steps)
nodes.rationale: Adds active_story_id/active_plan_path to sessions and creates stories/plan_tasks/plan_steps tables. Applied in filename order after 001 by the migration runner.

nodes.label: React dashboard SPA (Vite + TanStack Query + Zustand)
nodes.rationale: packages/web served from disk by the daemon's Bun HTTP catch-all. Hash routing (no server catch-all for fragments), TanStack Query for REST, Zustand for WS live state. Port/token read from URL params opened via /throughline:open.
nodes.norm_label: react dashboard spa (vite + tanstack query + zustand)

nodes.label: useWebSocket hook (live cache invalidation)
nodes.rationale: Opens ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/ws?token=<token>; on plan.changed/story.changed invalidates the matching React Query cache; exponential backoff reconnect 1s->30s infinite retries.

nodes.label: StandupService (prior-calendar-day digest)
nodes.rationale: SQLite-only. shipped = done stories updated in prior calendar-day window; inProgress = in-progress now; blockers = same tool PostToolUseFailure >=3x within a session in last 24h, mapped to active_story_id.

nodes.label: HandoffService (markdown handoff generator)
nodes.rationale: generate(storyId) reads story + linked plan, assembles header/Next Up/Story Body, writes .throughline/handoffs/<date>-<storyId>.md and inserts a handoffs row. extractPlanSummary picks the first task with no completed step.

nodes.label: StoryService reconcile() + deletion/title sync fixes
nodes.rationale: Fixes: deletions were silently dropped when readFile returned null; title never synced from frontmatter (COALESCE kept stale title); no startup reconciliation. Adds a 30s reconcile() existence diff and startup pruning in loadAll(). Scoped entirely to stories/index.ts.

nodes.label: DocsPage (combined tabbed Spec/Plan view)
nodes.rationale: Replaces separate SpecPage/PlanPage with one /docs route; tab state via ?tab=spec/?tab=plan useSearchParams, default spec if linked_spec_path set. Reuses existing /api/specs and /api/plans endpoints; no new server code.

nodes.label: spec-viewer agent skill (DocsPage design contract)
nodes.rationale: A visual/design-token contract (not implementation guide) so agents building or modifying DocsPage produce output consistent with the existing CSS: green for spec/active, blue for plan, Source Code Pro for labels, no AI-default purple gradients.

nodes.label: /throughline:start status-branching mode files
nodes.rationale: Step 4 branches on story status: backlog->brainstorming, in-progress->progress report, done->closure review. Mode files live in lib/start/ (not commands/start/) to avoid registering as slash commands; unrecognized status falls back to backlog. done.md must assess completion from git log, not checkbox state (checkboxes stay unchecked even when done).

nodes.label: HandoffService.generateForSession + 'This session' mining
nodes.rationale: Fires from SessionEnd/PreCompact as fire-and-forget (.catch(()=>{})) so the observer never blocks or throws. Mines a deterministic '## This session' block (files edited, commits, tests, tools failing >=3x, goal) from the events table via JSON_EXTRACT. story_id set => story handoff, else session handoff; no extra column. The activity block is the cross-session-memory moat.

nodes.label: GET /api/handoffs/latest endpoint + resume surfaces
nodes.rationale: Returns newest handoff (optionally by ?story) enriched with title/content/age, 404 when none. Surfaced by a SessionStart bootstrap.sh nudge, the new /throughline:resume command, and injected into /throughline:start as '## Last handoff'. Callers treat 404 as 'no handoff' and proceed unchanged.

nodes.label: Migration 005_handoff_session (nullable story_id + session_id)
nodes.rationale: SQLite cannot drop a NOT NULL constraint in place, so the handoffs table is rebuilt (create-copy-drop-rename) with story_id relaxed to NULL and a new session_id column, recreating indexes idx_handoffs_story and idx_handoffs_ts from migration 003.

nodes.label: notes-check.sh Stop-hook (staleness detection)
nodes.rationale: Re-surfaces the constitution's 'maintain running implementation notes' rule on every Stop because a one-shot SessionStart injection loses salience. Uses git status --porcelain + file mtimes (no tool-call bookkeeping), emits a block decision when notes are stale, but authorizes the agent to conclude 'nothing worth logging' since the hook can only judge staleness, not relevance. Preserves the observe-only stance for tool calls.

nodes.label: 2-strike fail-open cap (per-session counter)
nodes.rationale: Counter at .throughline/notes-nudge/<session_id>.count blocks on strikes 1-2 then fails open on the 3rd so it can never deadlock a session; resets when notes become the newest touched file. Mirrors the constitution's 'escalate after 2 failed iterations' threshold.

nodes.label: Per-session notes pointer-file resolution
nodes.rationale: Each session gets its own gitignored .throughline/notes/<slug>-<timestamp>.md, resolved via .throughline/notes/<session_id>.pointer. One level of indirection lets the bash hook (which has no conversation context to invent a human-readable slug) still locate an agent-chosen filename deterministically. Supersedes the single root implementation-notes.md, giving up reviewer visibility for per-session traceability.

nodes.label: sync-version.mjs (single-source version propagation)
nodes.rationale: Root package.json is the single authoritative version; sync-version.mjs propagates it to all derived locations (package.jsons, plugin.json, the VERSION literal in index.ts) so no file drifts. All packages share one version, no independent per-package versioning.

nodes.label: release-it local release config
nodes.rationale: release-it bumps root package.json, runs sync-version.mjs as after:bump, prepends CHANGELOG.md from conventional commits, commits chore: release vX.Y.Z and pushes a tag. github.release:false because CI creates the release. Later removed in the plugin-distribution redesign.

nodes.label: GET /api/status version surfacing
nodes.rationale: Daemon exposes running version via GET /api/status; the dashboard Topbar consumes it and the throughline:status command prints it from runtime.json.

nodes.label: Curated dist branch + single tag per release
nodes.rationale: Installing from marketplace source ./ pulled the entire monorepo. Fix: CI builds a force-pushed history-less dist branch (bundled server, built web, plugin resources only) and tags v${version} on the dist commit, not main. main's release commit is identified by message alone since a tag name is unique per repo.
nodes.norm_label: curated dist branch + single tag per release

nodes.label: scripts/release.mjs (bumpVersion, replaces release-it)
nodes.rationale: release-it removed as ceremony not load-bearing for a solo-maintainer flow. Plain script does clean-tree check, semver-segment bump, calls syncVersion (extended to also sync .claude-plugin manifests, fixing a 0.1.0 drift bug), prepends CHANGELOG from git-log --grep range, commits chore: release, pushes main. No tag on main.

nodes.label: webDistPath / THROUGHLINE_WEB_DIST resolution fix
nodes.rationale: Bundling rewrites import.meta.dir, so server.ts's join(import.meta.dir,'../../web/dist') offset climbs above the artifact and 404s every page. Fix threads DaemonOptions.webDistPath / THROUGHLINE_WEB_DIST env var through startDaemon; dev unaffected because the env var is unset. bootstrap.sh/ensure-daemon.sh set it to $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/bin/web in prod.

nodes.label: workflow_dispatch trigger + in-CI version bump
nodes.rationale: Replaces the push+commit-message-gated trigger (which re-published already-released versions, causing HTTP 422 tag_name already exists) with manual workflow_dispatch + required version_bump choice. Bump moves into CI, reusing scripts/release.mjs unmodified. Partial-failure recovery after the bump commit is documented, not automated.

nodes.label: Duplicate-release pre-flight guard
nodes.rationale: Predict the target version with bumpVersion (dry run, no writes), then fail fast if git rev-parse <tag> or gh release view <tag> already exists, turning today's opaque 422 into a clear early failure before any commit is pushed.

nodes.label: Root README positioning (observer-only, local-first)
nodes.rationale: Layered front-door README: adopter pitch then collapsible Development section. Tagline frames the brainstorm->spec->plan->implement lifecycle on a live Kanban board; trust framing throughout is observer-only / local-first. Visuals captured live from the running dashboard via Chrome.
